verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Kintsugi's nexus tracking, registrations, filings, and exemptions entirely in the context of what reads as US-style sales tax compliance (physical/economic nexus, state jurisdictions) with no mention of VAT, GST, EU OSS/IOSS schemes, or foreign country registration thresholds for UK/Canada/Australia. Since a sales-tax compliance platform could plausibly extend to international VAT/GST, the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence confirms this capability.
